8097146_998f6a15.text: While cells in the ventrobasal nuclei (VB) undergo a developmental switch postnatally in their expression of GABA A R subunits, neurons in the nucleus reticularis thalami (NRT) do not undergo such a switch (Laurie et al., 1992)

8097146_9fdcba62.text: .In contrast, no tonic current was observed in NRT cells, which do not express α4 or δ subunits (Cope et al., 2005)(Jia et al., 2005).
